changes.summary: the one seam: re-exports the primitives and owns rise / stagger / riseChild / pop, all transform-only.
mounts MotionConfig reducedMotion="user" once, inside the existing tree.
adds the smallest matchMedia stand-in jsdom lacks (Motion and next-themes both need it).
the workspace open: a staggered rise of the header and the document/rail row.
the roster rows rise in order.
the highlight list rises in order.
the review card and each candidate row rise in order.
the ephemeral chip pops in and out through AnimatePresence (scale-only).

decisions: One seam (shared/lib/motion) so the provider config, variants and reduced-motion stay in one place — the pdf.ts/supabase.ts/opfs.ts pattern.
Transform-only entrances: an entrance must never be able to hide the app when rAF is paused (a background tab).
Motion is DOM-only; the Konva canvases keep their painters.
